scenarios.name: creature-entry-trigger-fires-an-additional-time
scenarios.why: Panharmonicon affects a permanent's own enters-the-battlefield triggered abilities as well as other abilities that trigger when that permanent enters: Elvish Visionary entering causes its own draw trigger to fire an additional time, drawing two cards.

scenarios.name: without-it-the-trigger-fires-once
scenarios.why: Control: with no Panharmonicon in play the same entering creature's own draw trigger fires only once.

scenarios.name: once-per-turn-trigger-is-not-doubled
scenarios.why: Welcoming Vampire's ability says it triggers only once each turn. CR 603.2d has the game determine how many times the ability should trigger, and that restriction caps the count at one, so Savannah Lions entering draws one card, not two.
